newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end higher in late buying spree.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end higher in late buying spree.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures closed higher in thin volume, as many traders opted out of the market to attend the National Juice Products Association meeting in Arizona, market sources said.

Early speculative buying touched off stops in May at 76.00 cents and rallied the contract to 76.50 cents. The market drifted above unchanged until just before the close, when a bout of speculative buying fueled May to a high of 77.00 cents amid light trade.
Resistance was pegged between 77.00 and 78.00 cents basis the May contract.
The spot month closed up 1.90 cents to 76.70, having traded from 77.00 to 74.50 cents. July ended 1.90 firmer at 79.20, while the outer contracts finished 2.10 to 1.80 firmer.
Volume was estimated at 2,500 lots compared with Tuesday's official 3,400 lots.
Open interest in May fell 373 lots to 10,132 lots while July gained 412 lots to 10,519 lots, as of Monday's close.
